Subject: MAP Draft - Vendor Onboarding / Procurement Steps

Hi Jane / Acme AP team,

Great to meet you on the call this morning - thanks for walking through your requirements. As promised, attached is a first-draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) focused on the vendor onboarding / procurement milestones we'll need to close to get Redwood set up as an approved supplier in your systems.

Quick post-call recap & next steps I think will help keep this moving:

MAP milestones (draft)
- Milestone 1 (Vendor Registration): Acme to create vendor record in Coupa/Ariba and provide vendor code. Target: 2026-06-30.
- Milestone 2 (Vendor Forms): Acme to provide any vendor-specific questionnaires; Redwood to complete and return within 2 business days. Target: 2026-06-24.
- Milestone 3 (Tax Forms): W-9 exchange and confirmation. Target: 2026-06-24.
- Milestone 4 (Banking): Provide wire/ACH details for payments (secure). Target: 2026-06-30.
- Milestone 5 (PO / Contracting): Finalize SOW / PO issuance, sign-off. Target: 2026-07-01.

Proposed responsibilities
- Acme AP / Procurement: Create vendor record (Coupa), share vendor code, complete vendor questionnaire, confirm payment terms.
- Redwood (Rafael / Camila): Provide vendor packet (MAP, W-9, payment instructions), complete questionnaire, attend procurement kickoff.
- Redwood Finance (Marissa): Provide wire/ACH instructions and invoice template.

Dependencies / blockers
- Need to know whether you require a Coupa supplier code or Ariba supplier setup (you mentioned Coupa on the call).
- Any additional internal approvals or security questionnaires that would add time? Please flag.

Action items for this thread
1) Jane / AP: Confirm Coupa vs Ariba and provide the AP contact who will own the vendor setup (name + email).
2) Acme: Share vendor questionnaire and any PO template.
3) Redwood: We'll fill the questionnaire and send an updated MAP with explicit owners/dates.

I attached the MAP draft for your review (Redwood_MAP_v1.3.pdf). If it looks good I can update with the vendor code and return dates after your reply. Would you be available for a 15-minute handoff call with Tom Walker (AP lead) on Thursday 6/24 at 11:00am PT?

Thanks - looking forward to closing this quickly.

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Senior Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference

Thanks for the recap and the MAP - appreciate the clear milestones. We use Coupa for vendor management (confirmed). I'm looping in our AP lead Tom Walker (tom.walker@acme-corp.com) on this thread; he'll own supplier setup.

I attached our standard vendor questionnaire and a filled copy of the W-9 we have on file; please review and let me know if you need additions. For banking, we require a secure link to a vendor's payment instructions (we cannot accept wire details in-line via email). If you can provide a secure doc link or DocuSign, that would work.

We can do the 15-min handoff Thu 6/24 at 11:00am PT - Tom is available then.

Jane / Tom - thanks for confirming Coupa and for sending the questionnaire. Per internal coordination, please find an updated MAP attached (Redwood_MAP_v1.4.pdf) that includes explicit owners, target dates, and the items we discussed on the call. Summary of updates below:

Updated MAP highlights
- Milestone 1 (Vendor Registration in Coupa) - Owner: Tom Walker / Acme AP - Target: 2026-06-30 (Acme to create supplier and share Coupa supplier code).
- Milestone 2 (Vendor Questionnaire) - Owner: Rafael / Redwood - Target: 2026-06-24 (we will complete and return within 2 business days of receiving your questionnaire).
- Milestone 3 (Tax Form / W-9) - Owner: Marissa Cole / Redwood Finance - Target: 2026-06-24 (Marissa will upload W-9 to secure link).
- Milestone 4 (Banking / Payment Instructions) - Owner: Marissa Cole / Redwood Finance - Target: 2026-06-30 (we will provide a secure link to Redwood_Wire_Instructions.pdf).
- Milestone 5 (PO / Contracting) - Owner: Acme Procurement / Redwood Legal - Target: 2026-07-01.

Attachments included: Redwood_MAP_v1.4.pdf, Redwood_Wire_Instructions.pdf (secure link also provided below).

Secure payment instructions (per your request): https://docs.redwood.com/s/secure/Redwood_Wire_Instructions

Next steps / action items
- Tom: please create the supplier in Coupa and share the supplier code on this thread.
- Acme AP: review and return the questionnaire by 6/24.
- Redwood (Marissa): upload W-9 and wire instructions to the secure link by 6/24.
- Rafael / Camila: attend the 15-min handoff Thu 6/24 11:00am PT for quick alignment.

Please reply here if anything needs to be adjusted. If all good I'll mark the MAP as current and we'll move to vendor setup.

Best,
